stories.title: Springfield Hotel gym plan approved by Flintshire County Council
stories.summary: The Springfield Hotel in Pentre Halkyn can turn a four-bedroom bungalow in its grounds into an extra fitness studio after Flintshire County Council approved the plans. stories.title: Community groups in Wales could get first refusal on pubs, halls and chapels under new plans
stories.summary: Communities could get first refusal on valued local buildings and land when owners decide to sell. A consultation runs until the end of January.

stories.title: Remembrance soldier and poppy stolen from Connah’s Quay roundabout, councillor says
stories.summary: Cllr David Richardson says the figure was put up in memory of the fallen, including the father of the man who installed it.

stories.title: Flintshire council tenants paying £80 a year for TV aerials under 1999 contract
stories.summary: Council tenants in Flintshire are paying £1.55 a week for communal TV aerials under a contract that dates from 1999, a meeting has heard. stories.title: Hawarden’s new cemetery won’t be in Hawarden, councillor says
stories.summary: The site now proposed for Hawarden’s new cemetery is not in Hawarden, a Flintshire councillor has said, as the council seeks a further £325,000 for the scheme.
